modelDescription: Perfect for the mountains or snowy landscape, the Tikka T3x Lite Veil Alpine Bolt-Action Rifle delivers outstanding performance in extreme conditions. The T3x features a Veil Alpine camo synthetic stock, a highly accurate, cold hammer-forged barrel, and a butter-smooth receiver. A high-quality recoil pad makes shooting the T3x Lite extremely manageable, and interchangeable grips allow you to modify the angle of the grip for shooting from multiple positions. Additional screw placements on top of the receiver provide for secure attachment of a scope base or Picatinny rail. The T3x uses a 2-lug bolt with a 75° lift that cycles smooth as silk. The 75° bolt lift aids in keeping hand and gloves away from the scope and speeds the cycling process.
